newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nat Bank NZ signs US$500 mln Euro note programme.
newsitem.headline: Nat Bank NZ signs US$500 mln Euro note programme.

text.p: The National Bank of New Zealand on Friday announced the signing of a US$500 million Euro medium term note programme.
"The Euro medium term note programme will enable The National Bank of New Zealand to further diversify the sources of funding for the bank's operations," National Bank said in a statement.
The National Bank of New Zealand is a wholly-owned unit of Britain's Lloyds TSB Group Plc.
The arranger of the programme is Merrill Lynch International.
Dealers on the programme are: ABN AMRO, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Lloyds Bank plc, Merrill Lynch International, Nomura International and SBC Warburg.
